injections.name: bad-config-deploy
injections.description: Overwrite the gateway's config in place with one the production validator refuses at boot (cp keeps the file's owner and mode, so the gateway can still read it), then restart the gateway. The watchdog (deploy/systemd/omnidesk-watchdog.service) must restore its last known-good snapshot and restart. Precondition: the watchdog has seen the current config healthy for --good-after (300 s). After the run, the gateway journal must show the validator's refusal (gateway.allow_local_admin_without_token must be false in production), not a read error.
